notes.title: Cards and Debates
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[b]The new major update for Vox Populi: Spain 2023 is finally available![/b]

[b][u]Warning[/u][/b]: Launching this version will automatically delete your old saves.

[b]Here are the main additions to the game:[/b]

[list][*][b]A new debate and card system[/b], including the ability to speed up debates, and a new resource: Rhetoric points, with which you can buy new cards for your deck
[*][b]A better balance of difficulty[/b]: some scenarios will be a little less difficult to win, and the final situation between opposing characters will be more realistic.
[*][b]A redesigned interface[/b], including the ability to close almost all panels with the "Escape" button or by clicking outside, keyboard shortcuts to open them, and a windowed mode for the game
[*]Streamer mode and a victory music
[*]Two new Steam Achievements
[*]Several minor additions and fixes[/list]

[b]Please report any problems or bugs! Enjoy the game![/b]

notes.title: USA and Science fiction
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Before the future major updates to Vox Populi: Spain 2023, the new game in the franchise, '[b]Vox Populi: USA 2024[/b]' is now available! Take on the role of one of the candidates in this year's US presidential election, or start one of the [b]seven other fictional scenarios[/b] available!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3061790/Vox_Populi_USA_2024

Here's a non-exhaustive list of what's new from this version:

[list][*][b]Unique events[/b] linked to real events in the country
[*]A new voting system: the [b]Electoral College[/b], with new [i]Winner-take-all[/i] strategies
[*]A [b]referendum system[/b] that allows candidates to pass laws that give them an advantage or a total victory
[*]A new deck building system and a new resource: [b]Rhetoric Points[/b]
[*][b][u]But most importantly[/u][/b]: [b]Science fiction scenarios[/b] with their own ideologies, corpuses, character traits, events and regions. You can play as an alien, an advocate of equality between species, or the opposite, of the domination of one species over another.[/list]
If you wish, our [u]new Discord server[/u] has just been updated so we can communicate: https://discord.com/invite/N8E5Yc72Ym


[b]See you soon![/b]

notes.title: Europa and España
notes.content:
Hello everyone! An announcement to talk about the new game in the [b]Vox Populi[/b] franchise and upcoming updates for [b]Vox Populi: España[/b].

[h1][u]Vox Populi: Europa 2024[/u][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2842880/Vox_Populi_Europa_2024

[b]Vox Populi: Europa 2024[/b] was released yesterday on Steam. The game focuses on the European Union and contains many new features:

[list][*] Seven scenarios, including the 2024 European Union elections and many other futuristic fictional scenarios
[*] A new mechanism of laws and referendums to be organised during the campaign
[*] Unique combinations of ideologies and Corpus, linked to dozens of new European and national flags.
[*] A new system of political paths specific to Europe, allowing players to navigate between Europeanism, Socialism and Sovereignism[/list]
With the [b]Vox Populi - Collection[/b] Bundle, you can also get all the games in the franchise for cheaper :

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42066/Vox_Populi__Collection


[h1][u]The future of Vox Populi: España[/u][/h1]

There is at least on major free update planned for [b]Vox Populi: España 2023[/b] in the coming months, improving the debate system.

[b]See you soon for more news![/b]

notes.title: V1.01.02
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here's what's new in this update:
[list][*][b]Important[/b]: The bug that caused an error panel to appear has been fixed. All players who currently have saves will see a new panel asking them to delete them. After that, there should be no more problems.
[*]Debates in the 'Freedoms' and 'Unity' scenarios now act on 2 regions (normal debates) and 5 regions (great debates), so they can be won more quickly.
[*]A bug in the "Unity" scenario has been fixed. Until now, there weren't enough political points to win it.
[*]Some regional flags have been reworked.
[*]Various corrections and bugfixes.[/list]

Please report any other bugs or problems. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Regions & Freedoms
notes.content:
The new major update "[b]Regions and Freedoms[/b]" is now online. It brings a wealth of new content to "[b]Vox Populi: Spain 2023[/b]":

[list][*]Eight new fictional [b]scenarios[/b]. These take place between 2024 and several future dates, and feature a high degree of randomness for greater replayability.
[*] The addition of the [b]Canary Islands[/b], [b]Ceuta[/b] and [b]Melilla[/b]
[*] Random events concerning the independence of several Spanish regions or Moroccan diplomacy, which you can influence. A way to gain national popularity, or get rid of autonomous communities that are too favourable to your opponents...
[*] A new [b]presidential election system[/b], for one of the scenarios.
[*] A new [b]city scene[/b].
[*] A new ideological corpus: "[b]Socialist International[/b]".[/list]

A few words about two important scenarios, "[b]Freedoms[/b]" and "[b]Unity[/b]", created specifically for Spain:

[list][*] In these scenarios, a new ideological theme: "[b]Centralization[/b]" and two other new ideological corpus.
[*] These scenarios feature [b]40 new fictional regional flags[/b], pro-independence and republican or communist.
[*] The character is either an independentist or a centralist. Your objective is not to get elected, [b]but to convince the regions to take their independence or, on the contrary, to become Spanish again[/b] through debates.[/list]

[b]Finally[/b]:

[list][*] A better balance of difficulty. Characters at the top of the rankings will be attacked less often.
[*] Some corrections and bug fixes.[/list]

This version (1.01.01) is incompatible with previous saves. Revert to a previous version if you wish to continue.
Please report any bugs or problems you see, as they will be fixed promptly.

[b]Enjoy the game![/b]

notes.title: V1.00.03
notes.content:
Hola a todos:

Esta versión trae algunas modificaciones. No es compatible con las antiguas partidas guardadas. Deberán regresar a las versiones anteriores si desean continuar con ellas.

[list]
[*]- Ahora es posible realizar acciones y asignar actividades durante los eventos, excepto en casos particulares.
[*]- El juego está mejor equilibrado y alcanzar más del 50% de votos es un poco más fácil.
[*]- Los logros se obtienen con todas las victorias posibles. Un nuevo logro (Aplastante victoria) se obtiene únicamente con la mejor victoria posible.
[*]- Algunas correcciones de texto y errores.[/list]
Agradecemos que informen cualquier error o bug.
Pronto, habrá nueva información sobre los futuros escenarios que deberían llegar antes de finales de febrero.

----------------------------------------

Hello everyone!

This version introduces a few changes. It is not compatible with old saves. You'll have to go back to the old versions if you want to continue with them.

[list]
[*]- It is now possible to take actions and perform activities during events, with some exceptions.
[*]- The game is better balanced and achieving more than 50% of votes is a little easier.
[*]- Achievements are won with all possible victories. A new success (Landslide victory) can only be won with the best possible victory.
[*]- A few text and bug corrections.[/list]
Please report any bugs or errors.
More information on future scenarios is coming soon, and should be available before the end of February.

notes.title: v1.00.02
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This is a new update for "Vox Populi: España 2023".
Old saves for this new version will no longer work. Go back to "1.00.01" on Steam if you want to continue playing them.

List of changes :

- A tutorial is now available to better explain the game. If you feel that any information is missing or if you see any bugs or text errors, please report them.
This tutorial is the first step towards alternative scenarios for the game, which will be available for free before the end of the year.

- The guide is no longer displayed at the start of the game, but can still be opened from the options.

- A new map mode shows the regions where the player is under attack.

- Characters in the player's team can now be dragged from sociologies, regions and balances.

- Congress seats now display their candidates directly and can be clicked to display the characters's profiles.

- Some debate musics has been toned down.

- A few text and bug fixes. If there are any more, please tell about them. Thanks for your feedback!
